name: [Upd 10 // part 1] Superbox siege defense
desc:
(Superbox siege defense is Recommended to be played on private servers)
Superbox siege defense
A game where you fight heads coming out of boxes, it is technology vs boxes
You can unlock different characters by getting points from defeating the boxes.

Some boxes are stronger than others, there are multiple game difficulties you can choose.
